text:
Maria (Sales): FYI Acme wants a POC for enterprise auth — Azure AD + Conditional Access, SCIM group sync, and delegated RBAC mapping. They also want a pricing estimate for Dedicated and Private. Can we list blockers and timeline?
Liam (Solutions Eng): Quick checklist: 1) domain verification for tenant lock 2) SCIM delta + paging behavior 3) SAML assertions mapping groups -> RBAC 4) conditional access compatibility with our hosted endpoints.
Aaron (Acme IT): Confirming they run strict CA policies (MFA + compliant device). They also want SCIM to sync nested groups and map to our app roles. Are nested groups supported?
Liam (Solutions Eng): We support group members and can flatten nested groups during sync in the connector. Need to surface mapping UI for role->group rules. Also watch SCIM rate limits; for large orgs we recommend delta + pagination.
Jess (Security): For the security questionnaire: we can provide canned answers for SSO/SAML, SCIM encryption in transit, and KMS integration for Private. Need to confirm where logs are stored (retention & region) and whether PII leaves the VPC for Private deploys.
Olivia (Product): Product note — for Dedicated we can guarantee SLA and IP allowlist for Conditional Access. Hosted endpoints may require customer to allow our egress IPs or use Private mode. Need to capture which model endpoints they'll hit (low-latency vs high-throughput).
Maria (Sales): Pricing ask: Acme asked for a 3-week POC estimate and then a 6mo Dedicated commit quote. Can we get rough monthly numbers (dev + prod capacity) to feed into the finance template?
Liam (Solutions Eng): For POC: small Dedicated pool (2xA10G) + Private control plane -> estimate $Xk/month for prod parity, POC half that. I'll attach a specific template after we clarify expected tokens/sec.
Jess (Security): Also requirement: SCIM write operations must be auditable. We can surface SCIM audit logs to SIEM via syslog/S3 export in Private. For Hosted we'll provide webhook deliveries + limited retention. Need to confirm compliance requirements (SOC2, HIPAA?).
Aaron (Acme IT): They need SOC2 and ISO27001 evidence. Also legal wants SAML metadata exchange and SCIM SCIM bearer token rotation policy.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Rotation is supported via short-lived tokens + rotation API for Private. For Hosted we recommend rotating token quarterly; we can automate in Dedicated.
Maria (Sales): Any blockers to running the POC next week?
Liam (Solutions Eng): Blockers: 1) Acme must verify domain ownership (DNS TXT) for tenant pinning 2) Provide a sandbox AAD app with SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning credentials 3) Confirm expected user churn and group count (to size SCIM throughput).
Aaron (Acme IT): I'll ask them to create the app and drop SAML metadata. Expect ~120k users, ~4k groups, nested groups ~600. Churn moderate.
Liam (Solutions Eng): With that scale, plan for initial bulk run via SCIM bulk import (we can accept a CSV import in POC), then delta sync every 15 minutes; need to tune rate limits.
Jess (Security): Security questionnaire draft answer for "Where is user data stored?": "For Private & Dedicated deployments, user data and SCIM logs remain in customer VPC/region and can be exported to customer-managed S3/KMS. Hosted retention and region options available, see AO-PS-10."
Olivia (Product): Add a canary plan: route 5% of auths to POC endpoints for 48h, validate Conditional Access policies pass, then ramp. We'll include rollback to token-only auth if SAML assertion fails.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for shared-poc-env at 2026-04-02T08:00Z (infra change required).
Maria (Sales): Great — next steps: Liam to send SCIM mapping example + POC sizing; Jess to attach security questionnaire snippets; Aaron to request AAD app + metadata from customer. I'll assemble quote and proposed timeline. :thumbsup:
Liam (Solutions Eng): SCIM mapping snippet (example):
```json
{
  "userName": "urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1",
  "externalId": "employeeId",
  "groups": ["Engineering","SSO-Admins"],
  "roles": ["read-only","app-admin"]
}
```
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll follow up with the costing spreadsheet and a short runbook for DNS verification by EOD.
Jess (Security): I'll drop the relevant SOC2/ISO answers and an AAD conditional access note (we require IP allowlist or Private mode for strict CA) by EOD.
Maria (Sales): Thanks all — logging this thread for the deal.
